overall_safety_summary: One or more predefined rules were triggered.

hazards.description: A detected fork is close to the edge of its supporting work surface.
hazards.explanation: The fork could fall or be knocked from the surface.
hazards.older_adult_relevance: A small falling utensil may be harder to notice or avoid with reduced vision or mobility.
hazards.recommended_action: Move the fork inward and leave it flat on the work surface.

hazards.description: A detected bottle is close to the edge of its supporting work surface.
hazards.explanation: The bottle could fall, break or spill if it is knocked.
hazards.older_adult_relevance: A fallen container may create clutter or a slipping risk that is harder to recover from.
hazards.recommended_action: Move the bottle farther inward onto a stable part of the surface.

hazards.description: A detected bowl is close to the edge of its supporting work surface.
hazards.explanation: The bowl could be knocked over or fall from the surface.
hazards.older_adult_relevance: Spilled food or a fallen bowl may create clutter and require sudden movement.
hazards.recommended_action: Move the bowl farther inward onto the work surface.

hazards.description: A detected person is very close to a detected knife.
hazards.explanation: Close interaction with a knife may create a cutting risk.
hazards.older_adult_relevance: Reduced dexterity, grip stability or reaction speed may increase injury risk.
hazards.recommended_action: Keep fingers clear of the blade and use a stable cutting surface.

uncertainties: The baseline is limited to the fixed frozen ruleset and the available YOLO detections.
It cannot reason about heat, appliance state, hidden conditions or hazards outside its predefined rules.
